T1_any_injury.name: Target 1 (Any Injury vs. Property-Damage-Only)
T1_any_injury.description: Positive class indicates crash resulted in at least one injured person (K, A, B, C, or Injured-Unknown). Negative class indicates Property-Damage-Only.
T1_any_injury.formula: severe_crash_t1 = 1 if (A_CRAINJ in [2, 4] or any A_PERINJ in [1, 2, 3, 4, 7]) else 0

T2_serious_fatal.name: Target 2 (Suspected Serious Injury or Fatality vs. Non-Serious/None)
T2_serious_fatal.description: Positive class indicates crash resulted in at least one suspected serious (incapacitating) injury (A) or fatality (K). Negative class indicates minor, possible, or no apparent injury.
T2_serious_fatal.formula: severe_crash_t2 = 1 if any person in crash has A_PERINJ in [1, 2] else 0
T2_serious_fatal.national_weighted_rate: ~2.6% (matches federal highway safety severe crash statistics)
